paragraphs.english: Their mother counted the remaining blood-pressure drugs and found only twelve days of treatment. Fuel was also low, and the old batteries could hardly hold power. Shuo marked three goals on a paper map: a clinic, an electrical shop, and a fuel station in the nearest town. He and Yang would go alone. Taking their father would leave the wall without a builder. Taking either dog would add noise, consume water, and create another life to protect.
paragraphs.chinese: 母亲清点降压药，发现只剩十二天用量。燃料同样不足，旧电池也几乎存不住电。硕在纸质地图上标出三个目标：最近小镇里的诊所、电器店和加油站。他和洋两人前往。带上父亲会让围墙失去建筑工；带任何一只狗都会增加噪声、消耗饮水，还多出一条需要保护的生命。

paragraphs.english: They left before sunrise with one-third of a fuel tank, two empty cans, masks, gloves, bolt cutters, and food for one day. Yang recorded the distance at each turn. Fallen cars blocked the main street, so they parked behind a warehouse and continued on foot. A rapid tapping came from inside a bus, but they did not investigate. Every unnecessary stop increased the opportunity for infected people or armed survivors to find them.
paragraphs.chinese: 他们在日出前出发，油箱只有三分之一，另带两个空油桶、口罩、手套、断线钳和一天口粮。洋记录每个转弯处的距离。废弃车辆堵住主街，他们把车停在仓库后，改为步行。公交车里传来急促敲击声，两人没有查看。每一次不必要停留，都会增加被感染者或武装幸存者发现的机会。

paragraphs.english: The clinic had been searched before, but a locked cabinet still contained the drug they needed, bandages, alcohol, and water-treatment tablets. A body lay near the back door. They could not tell whether the victim had died from infection or violence. Shuo kept away while Yang used a mirror to check the corridor. They obtained only sealed supplies and placed anything with blood on it in a separate bag. Their mother's training had made the rule clear: unknown blood was a chemical and biological danger.
paragraphs.chinese: 诊所已经被搜过，但上锁药柜里仍有他们需要的药物、绷带、酒精和净水片。后门附近躺着一具尸体，他们无法判断受害者死于感染还是暴力。硕保持距离，洋用镜子检查走廊。他们只拿密封用品，并把任何沾血物品单独装袋。母亲的训练让规则很清楚：来历不明的血液同时具有化学和生物危险。

paragraphs.english: At the electrical shop, Yang found two deep-cycle batteries, a solar controller, copper wire, and fuses. Together the batteries weighed more than fifty kilograms. Carrying both would slow them, so they used a handcart. The fuel station had no working pumps, but an abandoned repair truck held diesel and tools. They used a hand tube to move the fuel into cans, stopping often to listen. By noon, heat and labor had consumed most of their drinking water.
paragraphs.chinese: 在电器店，洋找到两块深循环电池、一个太阳能控制器、铜线和保险丝。两块电池合计超过五十公斤，直接搬运会拖慢速度，他们便使用手推车。加油站的泵已经停转，但一辆废弃维修车里还有柴油和工具。他们用手动软管把油抽进桶里，过程中不断停下听周围动静。到中午，高温和劳动已经消耗了大部分饮水。

paragraphs.english: Three men appeared while they loaded the van and demanded half the supplies. Shuo saw no safe way to fight. He placed one fuel can on the ground and stepped back while Yang started the engine. The exchange cost them six liters, but it secured a clear road out. They reached home with medicine, power equipment, and enough fuel for several weeks. After washing outside and changing clothes, they entered the house. The trip had succeeded, but the town now knew that two brothers owned a working vehicle.
paragraphs.chinese: 两人装车时，三个男人出现，要求拿走一半物资。硕看不出安全战斗的可能，便把一桶燃料放在地上后退，让洋发动汽车。这次让步损失六升油，却换来畅通退路。他们带着药物、供电设备和可用数周的燃料回到家。两人在屋外清洗、更换衣物后才进门。行动成功了，但小镇上的人也知道，有两兄弟拥有一辆能开的车。
